title: callerya oosperma
intro: Callerya oosperma, commonly known as the Chinese yam or Chinese potato, is a plant species native to China. It is a perennial vine that has been used in traditional Chinese medicine for its numerous health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to promote digestion, relieve nausea, and support immune function. Its bioactive constituents include alkaloids, glycosides, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal effects.
